title: PAYANY.LINK
tagline: Send any money, from any where, to any thing. Imagine a universal router of stablecoins.
description:
This project uses tools like ENS and other bridging technologies under LiFi. Fiat settlement by paypal and stablecoin settlement layer by PYUSD.
How it works:
1. User visits: vitalik.eth.payany.link
2. Middleware detects subdomain: "vitalik.eth"  
3. Rewrites to: /sub/vitalik.eth
4. Dynamic route handles: /app/sub/[ens_or_address]/page.tsx
5. If you don't find the ens you are looking for you can still fuzzy search from our own indexing
Next thing we enable is payments.
Crypto Payments**: Native Web3 wallet integration
- **Fiat Integration**: PayPal payments via PYUSD facilitator
- **Cross-Chain**: Automatic bridging between networks
how_its_made:
The project uses a typescript convex powered backend, in a turbo monorepo setup. With a next js frontend setup. A shadcn + tailwind UI setup.
The "Particularly Hacky" Stuff Worth Mentioning

**The Subdomain Routing Hack** - T

The most innovative part in terms of UX is the **subdomain-to-ENS routing system**. This was actually quite tricky to implement correctly: Since we had a issue with DNS allowing wildcard in their top level sub domains. 
**The AI-Powered ENS Search** - RAG Implementation
The Problem**
We had 25,000+ ENS profiles in CSV format and needed **semantic search** - not just text matching.

**The Solution**: Custom RAG with Convex + Google AI

I had to invented a new 402 plus standard in order to open to the possibilities of accepting multiple currencies in both crypto and fiat across any chain.
